reviewers: expensive-agent: Type I / self-similar exclusion attack

findings.finding: Constantin-Fefferman vorticity-direction coherence does not supply a useful intermediate bridge to M_R: genuine coherence already proves regularity directly (non-modular), and coherence does not survive KNSS record-point rescaling.
findings.repair: Added refuted claim LOCAL-L3-FROM-VORTICITY-COHERENCE with both counterexamples in CRITICAL_PROFILE_ITERATION_004.md.

findings.finding: Adapting ESS's Carleman backward-uniqueness theorem directly to the KNSS profile fails: the velocity route contradicts the profile normalization, and the vorticity route needs an exterior zero terminal trace not supplied by finite energy, with a constant-solution counterexample surviving even that trace.
findings.repair: Added blocked claim LOCAL-L3-FROM-CARLEMAN documenting the exact missing hypotheses.

findings.finding: A Type I pointwise blowup rate does not bound local L3 mass, and applying NRS96's self-similar exclusion theorem would require the still-blocked BUP-003 (Type I implies self-similar tangent), making that route circular.
findings.repair: Added refuted claim LOCAL-L3-FROM-TYPE-I with an explicit concentrating counterexample.

findings.finding: The KNSS construction only constrains its rescaling centers to be spatial maximizers at record times; the proof of LOCAL-L3-CONTINUATION goes through with a strictly weaker hypothesis bounding local L3 mass only along a backward-tracked record-center trajectory rather than over all of R^3.
findings.repair: Added conjectured claim LOCAL-L3-RECORD-CENTERS (not proved, pending independent adversarial verification), narrowing the open target.

validation: Four independent expensive-agent subagents attacked LOCAL-L3-BOUND-DERIVATION from vorticity-direction, Carleman, Type I/self-similar, and hypothesis-weakening angles
One transient subagent API error (vorticity-direction attempt 1) was retried successfully
